name: hugmesh-tube-ui-e2e
description: Playwright + playwright-bdd e2e harness for the hugmesh-tube-ui federated remote (LocalTube — the optional, feature-gated tube service UI). Copied from the proven hugmesh.games/e2e pattern and mirrored on the merged wave-2b-1 admin-ui harness. Ships dark (wave 2b): every cluster-dependent scenario is @cluster-tagged so the suite compiles and discovers offline without a live stack.
